name: 26-background-gradient
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { height: 56px; margin: 8px 0; color: #fff; font-size: 13px; } .lin { background: linear-gradient(45deg, #ff0000, #0000ff); } .rad { background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, #00ff00, #000000); } .rep { height: 32px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 4px, #fff 4px 8px); } .stripe { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff0000 0 50%, #0000ff 50% 100%); }
html:
线性渐变 45deg
径向渐变 circle
重复条纹
硬边双色
